title: Ubisoft can deploy new releases in minutes with Octopus Deploy - Octopus Deploy
markdown:
![Ubisoft logo](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/186x169/ec4cfe4ecb/ubisoft-logo-white.svg)

![Requirements clipboard icon](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/67x67/e5d691425f/requirements-icon.svg)

#### Requirements

Automation

Kubernetes deployments

Modernizing deployments

![Company icon](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/67x67/27ba107a3d/company-icon.svg)

#### Company

21,000+ employees

![SaaS Industry icon image software as a service](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/67x67/77bbbb0f29/saas-industry-icon.svg)

#### Industry

SaaS

> ![Ubisoft Logo image](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/200x65/da9fde96b6/ubisoft-logo.svg)
>
> _With Octopus, we have experienced a significant reduction in deployment time. Now deploying new releases can be accomplished in a matter of minutes. Administrators and developers are no longer burdened with the monotony of repetitive tasks which is a game changer. We now channel our energy and expertise towards innovations, automatization, and projects that advance our industry forward._

> ![Ubisoft Logo image](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/200x65/da9fde96b6/ubisoft-logo.svg)
>
> _Automating and simplifying deployments was our main goal. With its multi-OS capacities, ease of use, and the execution of custom scripts and passing of values throughout the deployment process, Octopus has made our pipelines smoother and has organized and relieved a huge technical load from our admins._

![Ubisoft CI/CD pipeline](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/2381x954/f9ffdd5643/use-case-ubisoft.png/m/fit-in/1200x0/filters:quality(85):format(webp))![Ubisoft CI/CD pipeline mobile](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/1167x707/6129ed1787/use-case-ubisoft-mobile.png/m/fit-in/1200x0/filters:quality(85):format(webp))

> ![Ubisoft Logo image](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/200x65/da9fde96b6/ubisoft-logo.svg)
>
> _Octopus’s presentation and handling of multiple lifecycles and environments is the best I have seen._

> ![Ubisoft Logo image](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/200x65/da9fde96b6/ubisoft-logo.svg)
>
> _Octopus’s OpenAPI implementation makes it easy to script against and create automations to retrieve information. We use it for deployment histories across all our deployment targets, scraping the audit log, and mass-editing our channels and lifecycles. The interactive Swagger docs make it a breeze to find the info we need._
